scope: Finite-burst population scaling, analyzed separately for messages, signals and asynchronous batches. Same 100-recipient warmup, fresh owned schema and fixed resources for every cell.
inference_limits: Completion is an interval from original polling; no invented individual-workflow timestamps.
Medians bound the median of five cohort observations; they are not confidence intervals or a p95/p99.
Requests and final workflow outcomes are separate. Batch acknowledgment, recipient completion and batch bookkeeping are separate.
All attempts, failures, constraints and unattempted cells remain visible. Missing groups and pairs do not receive a replacement value.
No cross-pattern speedup ranking, sustainable arrival-rate capacity, live-model advantage or database-host headroom claim.
The two-second threshold is synthetic. Counts summed across patterns describe tested correctness, not aggregate payment throughput.
